equity.level_reason: HCV prevalence is reported by insurance coverage (an SES dimension) and described, but values are only set side by side with CIs, with no computed difference or ratio and no disparity framing; capped at 2.

level_alternative.reason: Insurance coverage is itself a social determinant as the stratifier; a reader treating 'greater... compared with private insurance' as a quantified contrast could give 3.

ev.q: greater among those with no insurance (1.7%) or public insurance (1.4%), compared with those with private insurance (0.3%).

equity.equity_measurement: Insurance coverage in three groups (none, public, private); private insurance is the implicit referent; public includes Medicare, Medicaid and other government plans.

ev.q: greater among those with no insurance (1.7%) or public insurance (1.4%), compared with those with private insurance (0.3%).

notes: Design not named; cross-sectional inferred from the NHANES survey sample. Survey weighting is not stated, so it is not recorded as a procedure. The 2.2 million infected adults is a population estimate in a footnote.
